entities.name: ActivityLog
entities.purpose: Audit trail. entityType + entityId (untyped) identify the acted-on entity.

entities.name: AirconCart
entities.purpose: Online staging. Lines are PULLED on checkout; no orderId back-reference.

entities.name: Assignment
entities.purpose: The operational job ticket. Own acceptance SLA + proof-of-work chain.

entities.name: AuthSession
entities.purpose: Session registry for token revocation. No back-pointer from User.

entities.name: BookingService
entities.purpose: AGGREGATE ROOT of the service business. Embeds services[], units[], inspection, diagnosis, quotation, warranty.

entities.name: Brand
entities.purpose: Product brand. Parent of Inventory and HVACProduct only.

entities.name: Category
entities.purpose: Product taxonomy. Parent of Inventory and HVACProduct only.

entities.name: CoreService
entities.purpose: Priced routine/maintenance service. `category` is free text.

entities.name: CustomerAsset
entities.purpose: A physical unit the customer owns. Polymorphic origin (booking|order).

entities.name: DailyAssignment
entities.purpose: One technician, one work order, one day.

entities.name: DailyKit
entities.purpose: Per-technician-per-day dispatch preparation sheet.

entities.name: EmailDeliveryLog
entities.purpose: Provider delivery record. PLAINTEXT recipient. No outboxId back-link.

entities.name: EmailOutbox
entities.purpose: Durable send queue. Payload AES-256-GCM encrypted; recipient stored as SHA-256.

entities.name: EmployeeCompensation
entities.purpose: Rate card history. Partial unique (employee, effectiveFrom) while active.

entities.name: EquipmentAssignment
entities.purpose: Per-work-day checkout/return with damage and overdue escalation.

entities.name: EquipmentUsageLog
entities.purpose: Free-text daily usage log. No quantity, so it cannot drive stock.

entities.name: Expense
entities.purpose: Technician field expense. Optional booking/project/workOrder link. NOT linked to Payroll.

entities.name: FailedLoginAttempt
entities.purpose: Brute-force throttle counter, one doc per email identity.

entities.name: HVACProduct
entities.purpose: Aircon catalog: one doc per model line with an embedded variants[] array.

entities.name: Inventory
entities.purpose: Flat SKU catalog: one doc per brand+modelLine+capacity. Legacy twin of HVACProduct.

entities.name: LeaveRequest
entities.purpose: Approved leave blocks technician availability. No secretary equivalent.

entities.name: LoginHistory
entities.purpose: Immutable audit row per successful login, geo/device enriched.

entities.name: MaintenanceSchedule
entities.purpose: Recurring maintenance cycle for an asset. Cyclic FK with CustomerAsset.

entities.name: NonWorkingDay
entities.purpose: Company- or service-scoped day off. Refs the LEGACY Service model.

entities.name: Notification
entities.purpose: In-app inbox. Dual-mode addressing: userId OR role broadcast.

entities.name: OperationLock
entities.purpose: Distributed mutex. _id IS the lock name. TTL on expiresAt.

entities.name: Order
entities.purpose: Aircon sale, online AND POS. salesChannel + fulfilmentType are separate discriminators.

entities.name: PartsRequest
entities.purpose: Procurement request when stock cannot cover a repair. Blocks booking in waiting_parts.

entities.name: Payment
entities.purpose: Financial transaction. FOUR parallel nullable parent refs, no discriminator.

entities.name: Payroll
entities.purpose: Payslip. attendanceSummary is a frozen snapshot, not a join to attendance rows.

entities.name: ProductRefund
entities.purpose: Money out for a return. returnId is UNIQUE, so at most one refund per return.

entities.name: ProductReturn
entities.purpose: RMA against an Order or a WalkInSale. Optionally reaches into WorkOrder.

entities.name: ProductReturnMovement
entities.purpose: Custody ledger for returned goods. Unique (returnId, type).

entities.name: Project
entities.purpose: Multi-unit engagement (8+ units) created FROM a booking. Root of delivery.

entities.name: ProjectIssue
entities.purpose: Technician-raised blocker during project execution.

entities.name: ProjectMaterial
entities.purpose: Inventory reservation line for a project. Holds the Tool pointer via bare sourceId.

entities.name: ProjectResourcePurchase
entities.purpose: Procurement record for a project resource shortage.

entities.name: ProjectWorkSubmission
entities.purpose: End-of-day proof of work + consumable declaration.

entities.name: Purchase
entities.purpose: Dead legacy model. Refs the unregistered model `Product`.

entities.name: Rating
entities.purpose: Feedback. targetType/targetId have NO refPath, so populate is impossible.

entities.name: RelocationRequest
entities.purpose: Pre-booking custom relocation quote across properties. Converts into a booking.

entities.name: RepairService
entities.purpose: Priced diagnostic-led repair. No category, no lifecycle fields.

entities.name: Role
entities.purpose: Permission matrix. Joined by name; system rows cannot be deleted.

entities.name: Secretary
entities.purpose: Dispatcher extension of User. Not unique-indexed (see risks).

entities.name: SecretaryAttendance
entities.purpose: One row per secretary per day. NO GPS evidence subdocument.

entities.name: Service
entities.purpose: Legacy 23-line stub, referenced only by NonWorkingDay.

entities.name: ServiceCategory
entities.purpose: Service taxonomy + unit types + inspection fees + warranty policy.

entities.name: ServiceReport
entities.purpose: Completion record, upserted per (bookingId, serviceItemId).

entities.name: ServiceToolUsage
entities.purpose: Material/parts CONSUMPTION ledger. Links booking/order/project/assignment.

entities.name: SiteSetting
entities.purpose: Untyped key/value runtime config. No owner, group or version.

entities.name: StockAdjustment
entities.purpose: Append-only before/after ledger for Tool quantity. Tool ONLY.

entities.name: StockReservation
entities.purpose: Soft or hard hold of Tool quantity for a repair booking.

entities.name: Technician
entities.purpose: Field-staff extension of User. Holds rating, availability and live GPS.

entities.name: TechnicianAttendance
entities.purpose: One row per technician per day. GPS + geofence + QR evidence.

entities.name: TechnicianSchedule
entities.purpose: Weekly working pattern + rest dates. UNIQUE per technician.

entities.name: Tool
entities.purpose: Service tools / parts / consumables. The ONLY catalog with a reservation ledger.

entities.name: ToolAssignment
entities.purpose: Simple long-term tool custody (no date dimension).

entities.name: TrustedDevice
entities.purpose: "Remember me" device token. tokenHash stored; TTL on expiresAt.

entities.name: UnitAssistanceRequest
entities.purpose: Pre-booking "I do not know my unit HP" quote. Converts into a booking.

entities.name: User
entities.purpose: Account. `role` is a STRING joined to `Role.name`, not an ObjectId.

entities.name: WalkInSale
entities.purpose: POS MERCHANDISE sale only. NO Payment document is created for these.

entities.name: WarrantyClaim
entities.purpose: Claim filed against a frozen warranty coverage snapshot.

entities.name: WorkOrder
entities.purpose: A scoped unit of project work. Unique (projectId, workOrderNumber).

entities.name: SessionStore
entities.purpose: Express login sessions stored by connect-mongo. Separate from AuthSession.

entities.name: paymentProofsFiles
entities.purpose: GridFS file metadata for payment receipts.

entities.name: paymentProofsChunks
entities.purpose: GridFS binary chunks; files_id points to the file metadata.

entities.name: completionProofsFiles
entities.purpose: GridFS file metadata for job completion proof photos.

entities.name: completionProofsChunks
entities.purpose: GridFS binary chunks; files_id points to the file metadata.
